title: SWF compiler: cacheAsBitmap not emitted in PlaceObject3 HasCacheAsBitmap bit
description: The model field 'cacheAsBitmap' exists in packages/core/src/engine/types.ts (line ~279) but compile.ts never reads it and never sets the HasCacheAsBitmap bit in PlaceObject3. When a display object has cacheAsBitmap=true, the SWF output should include a PlaceObject3 tag with the CacheAsBitmap bit set (bit 4 of the first flags byte, per SWF spec). This enables GPU-accelerated bitmap caching for complex movieclips in Flash Player / Ruffle.
